visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white ribbed turtleneck and blue jeans, stands in a brightly lit indoor space with white curtains. She holds a purple iPhone, gesturing enthusiastically while looking directly at the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a vertical screen recording of an iPhone's Settings interface. A hand with manicured nails navigates through 'General' to 'iPhone Storage', displaying a list of apps and their sizes. (3) The recording shows the Instagram app page within settings, highlighting the storage usage. A confirmation prompt for 'Delete App' appears and is tapped. (4) The screen capture transitions to the App Store, where the Instagram app is searched for and re-downloaded. Upon opening the app, it automatically navigates to the main feed. (5) The camera returns to the woman in the original setting. She continues her animated presentation, using hand gestures to emphasize points as graphical icons for Facebook, TikTok, and Spotify float on screen. (6) She concludes the video with a cheerful thumbs-up and a wide smile, standing in front of the same neutral, minimalist background.
